findings.summary: Rework round 2 kept the same write paths, and tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts is still not in them. Reproduced again: `pnpm exec playwright test --project=fresh-db` exits 1 at firstRun.spec.ts:93, and `pnpm test:e2e` exits 1 with 88 'main' tests not run, so harness RG-smoke fails. The spec tests the version 1 tour. Plan L281 replaces that tour in src/features/home/OnboardingTour.tsx: 9 steps in 2 modes with `tourSeen` per mode become 5 prototype steps with `tourSeenVersion: 2`. Plan L583 still runs firstRun.spec.ts, but no unit in the plan has it in its files. No PRD-compliant product change can make it pass. Line 93 expects the home after skip and reload, but step 1 opens /empresa/:id/relatorios and endTour does not navigate (prototype L1321-1322). Line 99 expects '#/inicio' after the '?'. Lines 103-111 expect a 4-step consultancy tour, while AC-ra-37 (prd L314) defines one 5-step tour for both modes, shown once. Why the engine keeps sending this back: in aioson src/agent-execution/execution-contract-repair.js, externalRepairPaths() routes only paths that appear in some plan unit's `files`. This path is in none, so the contract_change can never route, and every rework round restarts this supervisor with the same write paths. Fixing it needs a plan amendment (add tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts to phase-6-integration-e2e or to the integration-supervisor write paths) or the owner applying the patch below. Fix verified without touching the real file: a scratch copy with the patch below, run through a fresh-db-only scratch config, passes 5/5 (exit 0) in round 1 and again this round. Editing package.json `test:e2e`, the e2e fixtures or playwright.config.ts to make the stale spec pass would only hide it, so I did none of these. AC-ra-37 is also covered and passing in tests/e2e/home.spec.ts.

Fixed in the previous attempt and unchanged since; its verification still holds. The 'portfolio' member was added to reportSelectionSchema, the client ReportSelection in src/api/reportApi.ts was widened, and the cast in PortfolioReportPage.tsx was removed. tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts has the new portfolio cases, and tests/e2e/portfolioReport.spec.ts passes.

Fixed in the previous attempt and unchanged since. ReportWorkspace now passes the report type, the evolution range and evolutionSupported to ReportOptions, so the evolution PDF can be reached from the report center. tests/e2e/report.spec.ts exports it and compares its pages with the preview.

The declared paths src/features/reports/* now live in src/features/report-center/*. They were renamed earlier in this run because the aioson packager drops every folder named 'reports'. The edited ReportCenterPage.tsx and PortfolioReportPage.tsx are the renamed declared paths. Recreating src/features/reports/ would break the store package again.
Previous attempt, unchanged: createReportService now receives the app's `rules` (with `now`), so the evolution recalculates an older diagnosis with the same rules as the history routes.

Previous attempt, unchanged. reset() clears the brand and sets tourSeenVersion 2 and the 90-day reevaluation interval. backdateCompany() filters and shifts the v2 backup sections. New helpers cover brand, actions, diary, home and saved PDFs, and stubSystemOpener answers the open/reveal routes in the browser, so no viewer or Explorer window opens during e2e.
Not changed; the behaviour is verified by e2e. ConsultantHomeData has no awaitingQuestionnaires and CompanyAttention has no 'aguardando', so three pages widen the types locally. Type hygiene only.

Not changed: the data-aioson-tour anchors 'relatorios', 'marca' and 'modo' are absent, and the tour uses its data-aioson-id fallbacks. home.spec.ts and the scratch firstRun copy confirm that the 5 steps highlight 5 distinct regions in both modes.

The questionnaire and answers file names are slugified ('studio-norte-questionario-2026-10-25.html'), while the PDFs keep the version 1 names with spaces ('Studio Norte-2026-10-25.pdf'). The owner may want one convention.

The live Play preview (port 3543) holds data/fitpulse.db. A pnpm reinstall's postinstall migrate deploy therefore fails with 'database is locked'. In the previous attempt, one install was run against a run-scoped temp database. The preview was not touched; `pnpm dev` applies the 4 new migrations on its next start.

Owner-approved Q-10 test: open a generated questionnaire file in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on a computer with no internet, answer it, save, and import the answers. The e2e already covers Chromium offline with no network request.
'Abrir PDF' and 'Mostrar na pasta' inside the Play webview on Windows (OQ-ra-1): export the three PDFs with a brand and check that the default viewer and Explorer open on the saved file.
Report center open in the Play dev-link (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta): green badge, Relatórios tab, preview and export.
Print an exported PDF in grayscale and check that the charts and the risk levels stay readable.
Update a version 1 installation that has data through the Play, and check that companies, diagnoses, drafts and preferences are kept. scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs reproduces this flow and passes.

Play dev-link walkthroughs: with 3 months of diary, start and conclude a new diagnosis ('do diário, medido'); mark an overdue action as Feita, change the interval, switch modes and check both homes; import answers saved in another browser.
